component.name: Wallpaper Changer
壁纸更换器
component.summary: Set different wallpapers for each monitor on GNOME
为每个显示器设置不同的壁纸

description.p: Wallpaper Changer lets you set a different wallpaper for each monitor on GNOME desktops. It composes images into a single spanned wallpaper and supports automatic rotation with configurable intervals.

ul.li: Multi-monitor support with per-monitor wallpaper source folders
Automatic wallpaper rotation with configurable timer
GTK4 + libadwaita GUI with system tray integration

description.p: Initial release with multi-monitor wallpaper support.
